answer:
I’m not aware of a documented default for the `--max-retries` flag in the command‑line help.  
The only default retry setting mentioned in the docs is the provider‑level retry that Promptfoo applies when a provider’s `maxRetries` isn’t overridden:

> “Retries `callApi()` with 1‑second base backoff, up to **3 times by default**.”  
> [promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/rate-limits.md]
